gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-radio-canada-big: Snowburst One is a stencil face with wide gaps between its letters. Radio Canada Big, a sans-serif with a monoline skeleton, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly because its terminals stop well short of the stem.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-readex-pro: Snowburst One cuts stencil gaps between its letters, a bold, expressive display voice. But Readex Pro holds a steady weight from word to word, and that steadiness is what anchors the pair.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-ruda: Stenciled and loud, Snowburst One breaks its letters apart with wide gaps, while Ruda draws wire-thin monoline lines beneath it. Ruda's wide-mouthed rounds give the loud heading somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-saira: Wide stencil bridges cut through Snowburst One, while Saira stretches rounded letters high and leaves each s open. Bold stencil against clean sans: the difference is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-sarpanch: Expressive and bold, Snowburst One splits its stencil letters apart, while Sarpanch keeps an open mouth on each lowercase e. Its compact proportions let the heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-stack-sans-notch: Oxanium has a big-looking lowercase and uninterrupted monoline strokes. Stack Sans Notch brings open curves and rod-stock horizontals and verticals, so shrinking Oxanium would waste its big-lowercase presence.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads sturdy and marker-bold, with bulky lowercase proportions. Page after page, that steady weight keeps going without tiring, while Paprika scatters its letters and keeps the drama up top.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-savate: Snowburst One is all stencil attitude, with wide gaps between letters and a bold, expressive streak. And Savate, a sans-serif with open jaws on every curve, does the quieter work of staying legible.
gen-almendra-display-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Letters that never pinch shut give Almendra Display an ornate, literary look with a pronounced x-height. And Pilcrow Rounded handles the everyday reading, its big counters and tight letterspacing keeping things warm.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-yi: Autour One is bold, with a clear channel leading into each round letter, while Noto Sans Yi runs deep through the midsection. Give the heading generous size and let the body stay modest.
